value.body: A five-year programme that combines a bachelor's and a master's in the basic sciences, with a strong focus on research. The seven IISERs award a BS-MS dual degree; NISER Bhubaneswar and UM-DAE CEBS Mumbai offer a similar five-year integrated M.Sc. You study biology, chemistry, mathematics and physics first, then major in one subject and finish with a year-long research project.

items.label: Course length
items.note: 10 semesters; the final year is mostly a research project

items.label: Students in BS-MS programmes
items.note: All modes; all institutions reporting a BS-MS, not only IISERs

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Class 12 in the science stream. IISERs admit through the IISER Aptitude Test (IAT); the JEE Advanced and KVPY channels were dropped from 2024. NISER and UM-DAE CEBS admit through NEST (National Entrance Screening Test).

value.title: At a glance
items: IISERs are at Berhampur, Bhopal, Kolkata, Mohali, Pune, Thiruvananthapuram and Tirupati.
The programme is designed as a route into research; many graduates go on to a PhD.
Graduates also move into data, analytics and industry R&D roles.

value.title: Students enrolled in B.S.-M.S. programmes
value.note: Programme row 'B.S.-M.S. (Bachelor of Science, Master of Science)' across all institutions that report it, not only IISERs and NISER. AISHE counts responding institutions only; coverage varies by year, so part of any change can reflect reporting rather than real growth.
value.source: AISHE 2021-22, 2022-23 and 2023-24, Table 11, programme-wise enrolment, all modes, actual responses (Ministry of Education)
